project: Before the Rain / 雨来之前
direction: Code-native garden cartoons retained. Levels 01 and 05 use two representative light-background sets with layered silhouettes, quieter scenic props and exact-collider hedge detail. Shared HUD refined; remaining 14 world sets retain Alpha art. Visual target pending Alan review.

code_native_art.collision_contract: Model authoritative, continuous local wind during cruise, release and charge; dash keeps direction. Only the player has collision and stamina. Rescued actors are bounded screen-plane departure animations with no physics or damage; follow/path and companion collision-offset logic removed. Full solid stem rectangles remain visible, flower direction and shelter position remain model-derived.
code_native_art.frame: Godot 4.6.2, Compatibility renderer, 1280x800 logical frame, keep-aspect, code-native AA outlines; no bitmap texture budget.

sample_sets.format: Original GDScript vector paths, no generated/raster asset or new third-party source
sample_sets.frame: 1280x800 keep-aspect; 960x600 native-window capture; Compatibility renderer. Filled shapes use same-color line AA, no unsupported 2D MSAA.
sample_sets.planes: sky / unoutlined low-contrast distant set / exact model-backed interaction silhouettes / bottom foliage
sample_sets.states: Existing charge, launch, rescue, leaf rest and goal landing retained and checked in actual input routes; additional wing veins and Xiaoman periodic local greeting. Presentation clock freezes on pause.
sample_sets.repeat_rule: Preserve authored collision footprint and gameplay hue roles. No decorative dark-outline props in sampled flight corridor; background objects do not acquire colliders. No bitmap production before this visual target is reviewed.
sample_sets.status: representative visual target, not approved commercial art

ui.source: Project Godot drawing and controls in main.gd; operating-system Chinese font fallback
ui.stamina: Five 20-point segments, numeric current stamina, pending burst cost highlight and delayed loss trail
ui.clock: Elapsed journey in ordinary levels; exposed-time budget and spatial chase in storm levels. Both stop at earned arrival.
ui.handoff: 2.4-second earned landing; region boundaries 4.5 seconds with season text. Enter skips, pause/focus loss freezes. Stage 04 continues into summer; only stage 16 ends the full journey.
ui.progress: 16 levels / 60 encounters / 38 shared safe leaves / 15 dew. Journey v2 path uses version 6, content revision 8; old journey v1 and chapter v4 untouched. Title region selection starts a new journey; earned arrival continues next stage.
ui.local_feedback: Actual wind contact has directional pushing feedback including charge; approach is explicitly not contact. Shelter and fresh/recovery state preserve safety. Fountain phase and material feedback retained.
ui.sample_revision: Light objective/stamina cards, measured cue/toast widths, small context-dependent footer, high-flight charge prompt below the bee. Five stamina segments and visible numeric drain remain.

rejected_pass.status: Removed from source/runtime/export following user feedback SF-R02: AI feeling too strong.
rejected_pass.retention: Original unchanged images, full image-generation prompts/provenance, native captures and interim app retained only in local outputs/swarm-flight/2026-10-20-finished-chapter/rejected-painted-pass; not required at runtime.

validation.engine: Godot 4.6.2 stable, OpenGL Compatibility on Apple M1 Pro
validation.result: 0.7.1: 1533 model checks, 60 per-level route checks, 449 native full UI/capture checks; final wind visual slice 30 checks. Ordinary key reproduction bypasses wind flowers: release 1s = -159.99px, charge 0.5s = -80px, zero bursts/recoveries. 54 old 0.7.0 checkpoint fixtures and actual save copy restore; no user save writes. Developer evidence only.
validation.rhythm_revision: 0.3.1 retains the original art and all music. Native input-route captures and technical checks recorded in the local rhythm-feedback delivery receipt; player feel acceptance remains pending.
validation.chapter_revision: 0.4.0 keeps all three original music arrangements unchanged; known-answer developer route is roughly 5-6 minutes, not evidence for the initial 20-30-minute first-play target.
validation.chase_revision: 0.4.1 retains map geometry, entity counts, control physics, stamina rewards and original music; authored section storm pace and clearer relay/chase feedback. Near-rain capture is an explicit UI state fixture, not a player run.
validation.living_revision: 0.4.2 retains all map, model, input, save and audio source. Revises silhouettes, action poses and bounded plant reactions. Real v2 progress is checked from an isolated copy, never overwritten by QA.
validation.rescue_revision: Existing geometry, resources, player collision, rain and music retained. Native ordinary-key rescue tests cover temporary departures, pause, active player control, expiry, recovery and restart; save continuation never replays rescue effects.
validation.facing_revision: 0.4.4 fixes left-facing body inversion using horizontal mirroring plus pitch; resting bodies settle level. Model, input, saves and sound unchanged. Native directional/charge/dash/rest captures and checks recorded in the upright-flight delivery receipt.
validation.chapter05_revision: Five authored encounters per stage, three broad saves per stage, 20 optional dew, rescue distribution 4/2/1/1. Direct, all-dew and no-shield ordinary-input paths complete. Shield-turn fixture uses no dash and finishes before expiry; elapsed time is a known-answer route measurement, not first-play time.
validation.pacing_revision: Dew authored as ordered optional beats, rescue refill carries into subsequent flight, nine deliberate shelters, six dew with dynamic save/UI counts. Weather follows encounter purpose. Direct/all-dew/no-shield/flow-through complete without recovery; recovery test uses five explicit returns after rescues. Flow-through rain route reaches 2.07 stamina, not novice-tolerance proof.
validation.arrival_revision: Level 02 supply precedes the route split. Crossing the goal aperture completes before same-substep weather damage; model/time/stamina freeze throughout presentation. All music generation functions remain byte-identical to 0.5.1; only arrival bell synthesis added.
validation.full_alpha_revision: Twelve authored levels added; twenty-four per-level routes passed. Whole known-answer routes ~5m40s/~6m16s, not evidence for the unvalidated 2–3-hour first-play target. Original movement and sound.gd unchanged.
validation.season_routes_revision: 05–15 reauthored with 38 real terrain areas, 5 phased fountains, 6 local airflows. Twenty-four per-level routes complete with no terrain hits, fountain damage or recovery. Whole known-answer routes ~6m28s/~6m39s; not first-player timing. Spring definition and sound.gd remain byte-identical to 0.6.0. UI fixture captures are separate from continuous-input route captures.
validation.interaction_coherence_revision: Continuous local wind for idle/charge; dash resistance retained following explicit user clarification. All six authored airflow regions exercise state combinations, actual-key UI reproduction avoids wind flowers. Two updraft bounds clear solid terrain; existing progress layout and sound.gd unchanged.
validation.sample_revision: 0.8.0: 1577 model checks, 530 native complete UI/capture checks (two complete sixteen-level input routes), 140-rule airflow baseline and two old defects rejected by 12/6 behavior assertions. 12 targeted 05/actual-0.7.1-save continuation routes, all without collision/damage/recovery. Native 1280x800 plus 960x600 sample capture. Developer evidence only; no new player acceptance.

style_references.use: Broad garden-cartoon visual reference only; no characters, sprites, logos or screenshots are shipped.
Official soundtrack context for light, playful garden mood; no audio download, transcription or melody reuse.

audio.source: Original deterministic PCM synthesis authored in project code. No external samples, recordings or transcriptions.
audio.arrangements: Three original eight-bar / 32-beat A/B arrangements, 64 eighth-note slots. Offbeat plucks, toy keys/wooden mallets, alternating bass root/fifth, light percussion. Third act shifts to minor harmony and denser pulse.
audio.mix: Fixed synthesis gain 1.45; 1.2s stage music crossfade, 4dB event duck, retained mute and fixed 8-voice SFX pool.
audio.verification_output: SWARM_AUDIO_DIR or OS cache directory/before-the-rain-audio-qa; three WAVs and signal-report.json. PCM checks are technical evidence, not human listening acceptance.
